name: The Sanya EDITION
positioning: Resort on Hainan Island built around a man-made ocean, with ocean-view rooms, hillside villas and several restaurants
best_for: Travelers who want a beach resort with a man-made ocean and many places to eat on site
Guests who want a villa with a private pool on a hillside

facts.text: The property has two swimming pools.
The guest rooms are in a horseshoe-shaped hotel and all have ocean views.
Room interiors use light oak finishes, airy fabrics and limestone floors from Indonesia.
Bathtubs are positioned in the main room of the guest rooms.
Market at EDITION has food stations including a raw bar, a dim sum station and an open-fire grill.
Beach Barbacoa draws on the flavors of Indonesian cuisine.
BOHN serves traditional Hainanese fermented vinegar soup.
The Jade Egret serves modern European cuisine in a yacht-inspired space at ocean level.
The spa spans more than 2,000 square meters across two levels with extensive gardens.
Beach Club at EDITION has VIP cabanas flanking an infinity pool with views of the Private Ocean.
Luxury designer outlets are among the attractions nearby.

highlights.text: The property features a man-made ocean called the Private Ocean.
Guests can take an evening boat ride to the center of the Private Ocean and dine at a private table on an illuminated floating platform.
Market at EDITION has a design that evokes an old Chinese warehouse.
Xianhai by the Sea is the hotel's signature seafood restaurant and specializes in Cantonese cuisine.
Hotel villas are set into a terraced hillside and have private pools.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
WhataHotel notes the location is remote and needs transportation to reach the city center.
